scope: Small local library for tool use, score interpretation, strand orientation, seed limitations, expression context and provenance only
evaluation_boundary: Ten visible development checks, not independent scientific evaluation, no human scores and no comparison with the old 54 records

planned_cases.question: OligoFormer需要什么siRNA和mRNA输入，19个碱基和57个碱基分别是什么？
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Chinese query retrieves English source chunks; original file, page or fragment and actual excerpt can be opened

planned_cases.question: OligoFormer分数超过1可以解释为超过100%的敲低率吗？
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Separate official score scaling from project interpretation; do not report a measured knockdown percentage

planned_cases.question: 默认候选的21碱基guide和passenger、19碱基配对核心、23碱基设计窗口如何区分？坐标为什么不同？
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Cite actual retrieved material; label project coordinate derivation separately from literature; do not fabricate an order-ready duplex

planned_cases.question: SeedMatchR中guide的mer7m8种子匹配定义是什么，方向怎样确定？
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Retrieve English definition of g2-g8 and reverse-complement target; do not substitute current version for historical 1.1.1

planned_cases.question: seed匹配位点数和去重基因数是一回事吗？找到匹配能证明真实脱靶吗？
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Distinguish counts and reference scope; no inference of observed toxicity or experimental repression

planned_cases.question: 我们未转染的ARPE-19常氧和缺氧TPM，能用来证明某条siRNA的敲低效果吗？
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Label project setup and baseline evidence; do not infer siRNA perturbation response or new state-dependent ranking

planned_cases.question: 网站显示的默认九条OligoFormer和SeedMatchR结果是本次重新计算的吗，证据来源在哪里？
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Historical imports remain distinct from new local calculations; export includes corpus version, question, search terms and source chunks

planned_cases.question: 请给出本项目已经测得的人类患者视力改善百分比和临床给药剂量。
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Explicit evidence insufficiency; no fabricated clinical number, no unsolicited external search

planned_cases.question: 这个损坏的PDF能否作为原文依据导入？
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Reject malformed and image-only files with readable reason; no successful document or partial usable index; no OCR claim

planned_cases.question: 导出文库后重新导入，B01的英文片段、原始PDF页码和引用还能对应吗？
expected_sources: same originals and chunks as B01
planned_cases.expected_behavior: Hashes, metadata, library version and source locations preserved; rebuilt index retrieves same evidence; reject altered or unsafe archives

minimal_real_demo.entry: Authenticated existing UI with explicit model-usage confirmation; two questions only, no development-evaluation batch
minimal_real_demo.on_account_error: Stop immediately and retain actual request, response or diagnostics and unexecuted status
minimal_real_demo.record: All questions, retrieved excerpts, library version, answers, model requests/responses and usage; no independent scores
